# Cardiac catheter laboratories

!!! info "Definition"
    A cardiac catheter laboratory (cath lab) is a specialised hospital facility used for minimally invasive catheter-based procedures to diagnose and treat heart and blood vessel conditions.

## Activity classification

Activity includes spells meeting either of the following criteria:

* A valid procedure code in cardiology (320) or paediatric cardiology (321) treatment specialties.
* A primary procedure code in one of the following groups, regardless of treatment specialty:
    * K63: Contrast radiology of heart
    * K75: Angioplasty
    * K60: Cardiac pacemaker
    * K62: Therapeutic transluminal operations on heart
    * K59: Cardioverter defibrillator introduced through the vein
    * K57: Other therapeutic transluminal operations on heart
    * K73: Other cardiac pacemaker system through vein
    * K49: Transluminal balloon angioplasty

Spells meeting both criteria are counted once.

## Calculating capacity

#### Pathway: deriving workload

The primary procedure from each qualifying spell is used to estimate procedure hours using the assumed procedure time.

!!! quote ""

    $$
    \text{Procedure hours}
    =
    \text{Procedures}
    \times
    \frac{\text{Procedure time (minutes)}}{60}
    $$

#### Operating model: converting workload to capacity

Calculate the required number of cardiac catheter laboratories by dividing procedure hours by the product of the service's annual operational hours and the assumed utilisation rate.

!!! quote ""

    $$
    \begin{aligned}
    &\text{Required cardiac cath labs} \\
    &=
    \frac{\text{Procedure hours}}
    {\text{Annual operational hours} \times \text{Utilisation rate}}
    \end{aligned}
    $$

## Assumptions

Assumptions may apply to an individual subgroup, several subgroups or all groups.

| Subgroup | Assumption | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| All groups | Procedure time | Pathway |
| All groups | Utilisation rate | Operational |
| All groups | Annual operational hours | Operational |


## Notes

* Some included procedures, such as pacemaker insertion, may be undertaken outside a cardiac catheter laboratory depending on local service configuration.

??? info "Technical details"
    **Capacity outputs**

    * `CARDIAC_CATH_PROC_LABS`

    **Conversion archetype:** time utilisation · `FRM_TIME_UTIL`

    **Operational constraint:** available operational time, adjusted for utilisation

    **Workload object:** `procedure_hours`

    **Classification expressions**

    | Subgroup | Expression |
    | --- | --- |
    | All groups | ((`CLASS_CARDIOLOGY` AND `CLASS_HAS_PROCEDURE`) OR `CLASS_CARDIAC_CATH`) |

    **Classification definitions**

    | ID | Definition | Rule |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | `CLASS_CARDIOLOGY` | Cardiology or paediatric cardiology specialties | tretspef IN 320, 321 |
    | `CLASS_HAS_PROCEDURE` | Spell with recorded procedure | has_procedure = 1 |
    | `CLASS_CARDIAC_CATH` | Cardiac catheter-based procedures | primaryprocedure IN K63 (Contrast radiology of heart); K75 (Angioplasty); K60 (Cardiac pacemaker); K62 (Therapeutic transluminal operations on heart); K59 (Cardioverter defibrillator introduced through the vein); K57 (Other therapeutic transluminal operations on heart); K73 (Other cardiac pacemaker system through vein); K49 (Transluminal balloon angioplasty); |
